bbox.note: ~4.2 km east–west by ~6.7 km north–south, waterfront-centred on Al Corniche Street between Doha Port / Museum of Islamic Art (south) and West Bay (north), inland through Msheireb, Al Bidda Park, and the inner C-Ring approaches. Chosen so OSM-tagged vehicle signals land in the ~20–40 TLS compact band without inventing unsigned junctions.

typemap: data/typemap/osmNetconvert.typ.xml (default motor-vehicle OSM map; not UrbanDe — Doha arterials keep OSM maxspeed)
